headlines.text: Looking back to 2023, when there was a changing of the guard for the AEW World Tag Team Titles as FTR vs. The Gunns battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.53 ? ending the champion's reign at 8 defenses. With their AEW careers on the line, FTR overcame late interference and a title-belt headbutt to defeat The Gunns and reclaim the AEW World Tag Team Championship.
Turning the clock back to 2025: after 2 matches, Andretti & Rush debuted a bold new identity: CRU, on Collision.

That Wednesday in 2023, Chuck Taylor chalked up their 50th recorded AEW match ? a genuine milestone, facing House of Black vs. Best Friends & Cassidy, getting things started right out of the gate on Dynamite, rated 7.06 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle in a chaotic six-man affair.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2025, when it was Hobbs & Ishii's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.27 ? a well-worked match.
On this day in 2025, PAC vs. Cash Wheeler met for the very first time on Collision, rated 6.75.
Rewind to 2025, when Athena was back in action after a long-awaited stretch away after just under 12 months away, appearing on Collision.
